name: fixbug-loop
description: Disciplined bug fixing: reproduce -> competing hypotheses -> red test -> minimal fix -> verify
pattern: evaluator-optimizer (the red test is the evaluator)
whenToUse: There is an error/exception/wrong behaviour whose cause is not yet known.
whenNotToUse: The exact wrong line and its fix are already known -> fix it directly, still write the test.

steps.goal: Get the failure to happen first
outputs: The full ORIGINAL error message (stack trace included)
steps.exitCriteria: Reproduced. NOT reproducible => say so; every conclusion after that is SPECULATION and must be labelled.

steps.goal: Fight anchoring by holding several hypotheses before digging into any one
outputs: For each: 'if true, what ELSE must be true'
steps.exitCriteria: At least 3 hypotheses, each with a concrete DISCONFIRMING check
steps.note: Hunt for DISCONFIRMING evidence, not supporting evidence.

steps.goal: Turn the bug into a failing test
outputs: A test that reproduces the bug
steps.verifier: run the new test -> it must be RED
steps.exitCriteria: The test is RED, and red for exactly the reason the bug causes. Green right away => the bug is not understood yet.

steps.goal: Fix the CAUSE, not the symptom
steps.exitCriteria: No drive-by refactor. Wrapping the blow-up site in try/catch HIDES the bug, it does not fix it.
The new test is GREEN AND no additional old tests are red. Both, not just the first.

steps.goal: A bug is rarely in only one place
outputs: List of other places in the repo with the same defect pattern (write them down, DO NOT fix)
steps.exitCriteria: The defect pattern has been grepped across the whole repo

stopConditions.action: Pick ONE: change hypothesis | narrow the repro | stop and report
